, selected_channels AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.bridge_id,p.sscsdm,p.bsm AS point_id,d.bsm AS device_id,d.jczb AS metric FROM point_bridge p JOIN device_source d ON d.dwbsm=p.bsm AND d.sscsdm=p.sscsdm WHERE
p.bridge_id IN #{id} FALSE ), readings AS ( SELECT c.bridge_id,c.sscsdm,c.point_id,c.device_id,c.metric,s.jccjsj FROM selected_channels c JOIN dwd_ql_jc_jcz_inc s ON s.sscsdm=c.sscsdm AND s.dwbsm=c.point_id AND s.sbbsm=c.device_id AND s.jczb IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.metric WHERE coalesce(s.sjtbzt,'')!='D' AND s.jccjsj >= #{filter.from}::date AND s.jccjsj < (#{filter.to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM selected_channels) AS channel_count, (SELECT count(DISTINCT bridge_id) FROM selected_channels) AS configured_bridges, count(*) AS reading_count,count(DISTINCT bridge_id) AS bridges_with_readings, (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT sscsdm,point_id,device_id,metric FROM readings) channel_keys) AS channels_with_readings, min(jccjsj)::text AS first_time,max(jccjsj)::text AS last_time FROM readings
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN severity IN (4,5) AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (4,5)) THEN 'verify_severe' WHEN status IN (1,2,3) THEN 'follow_pending' WHEN status IN (4,5) THEN 'verify_closure' WHEN status=6 THEN 'review_deferred' ELSE 'complete_status' END
mapper.select: , matched AS (SELECT * FROM records r ) SELECT AS code,count(*) AS count FROM matched GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ,NULL::bigint AS matching_total FROM records r ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.severity IN (4,5) AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status NOT IN (4,5)) THEN 0 WHEN r.status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 WHEN r.status IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.id LIMIT 5
mapper.sql:
SELECT 'total' AS dimension,'all' AS code,count(*) AS count,min(occurred_at)::text AS first_date, max(occurred_at)::text AS last_date,max(source_updated_at)::text AS latest_sync FROM matched
UNION ALL SELECT 'maintenancePriority', ,count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY
UNION ALL SELECT 'city', r.city_code,count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY r.city_code
UNION ALL SELECT 'zone', coalesce(r.zone::text,'missing'),count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY coalesce(r.zone::text,'missing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'status', coalesce(r.status::text,'missing'),count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY coalesce(r.status::text,'missing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'severity', coalesce(r.severity::text,'missing'),count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY coalesce(r.severity::text,'missing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'damageType', coalesce(r.damage_type::text,'missing'),count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY coalesce(r.damage_type::text,'missing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'maintenanceType', coalesce(r.maintenance_type::text,'missing'),count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY coalesce(r.maintenance_type::text,'missing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'month', coalesce(to_char(r.occurred_at,'YYYY-MM'),'missing'),count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY coalesce(to_char(r.occurred_at,'YYYY-MM'),'missing')
UNION ALL SELECT 'resultProvided', CASE WHEN nullif(trim(r.result),'') IS NULL THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END,count(*),NULL,NULL,NULL FROM matched r GROUP BY CASE WHEN nullif(trim(r.result),'') IS NULL THEN 'no' ELSE 'yes' END
ORDER BY dimension,code
mapper.select: , matched AS (SELECT * FROM records r ), summary_rows AS (), example_rows AS (SELECT * FROM matched r ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.id LIMIT 3), candidate_rows AS ( SELECT * FROM matched r WHERE TRUEFALSE ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.severity IN (4,5) AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status NOT IN (4,5)) THEN 0 WHEN r.status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 WHEN r.status IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.id LIMIT 5 ) SELECT coalesce((SELECT json_agg(s ORDER BY dimension,code) FROM summary_rows s),'[]'::json)::text AS summary, coalesce((SELECT json_agg(e ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,e.id) FROM example_rows e),'[]'::json)::text AS examples, coalesce((SELECT json_agg(c ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.severity IN (4,5) AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status NOT IN (4,5)) THEN 0 WHEN c.status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 WHEN c.status IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.id) FROM candidate_rows c),'[]'::json)::text AS candidates
mapper.sql: SELECT ,NULL::bigint AS matching_total FROM records r ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST,r.id LIMIT 10
